name: Re-evaluation Report to Parents
description: Copies of the re-evaluation report are sent to parents ahead of the IEP team meeting.
deadline: at least 10 days prior to the IEP team meeting unless waived in writing
quote: Copies of the re-evaluation report shall be disseminated to parents/guardians at least ten (10) days prior to the meeting of the IEP team unless this requirement is waived in writing.
